acceptance: transpile_ddl covers the 'pure strip/convert' rules from the plan with tests that execute the produced DDL on sqlite, duckdb or Postgres (container) and compare the created schema.
SingleStore emitters take keys as arguments; no TPC-H table names exist in the fork; SingleStore execution evidence uses a container or is recorded as a gap.
DdlOptions is frozen, typed and documented in the fork README.
Fork make check, make benchbox-dist and make benchbox-check pass; PR merged.
description: Owner emphasis: DDL transpilation is first class. Add a frozen DdlOptions dataclass and transpile_ddl in sqlglot/benchbox/ddl.py. Core behaviors: strip primary/foreign keys and UNIQUE/REFERENCES (postgresql, ducklake, questdb, databend, firebolt), CREATE OR REPLACE (snowflake, bigquery, databricks), and SingleStore SHARD KEY, SORT KEY and REFERENCE TABLE clause emitters. Benchmark data (shard/sort key tables, reference table list) stays in BenchBox and arrives via DdlOptions.
